INSERT INTO crm_raw_records (
            organization_id,
            provider,
            crm_tenant_id,
            crm_connection_id,
            source_user_id,
            object_api_name,
            external_record_id,
            source_last_modified_at,
            source_deleted,
            payload,
            payload_hash,
            idempotency_key,
            ingested_at,
            storage_tier
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2::text::crm_provider,
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            $7,
            $8,
            $9,
            $10::text::jsonb,
            $11,
            $12,
            COALESCE($13, now()),
            $14::text::crm_raw_storage_tier
         )
         ON CONFLICT (provider, organization_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
         RETURNING id
